message.title: REACH SUBSEA ASA – Notification of trade by close associate of primary insider
message.body:
The Board of Directors of North Energy ASA decided on 4th of September 2026 the dissolution of the fully owned subsidiary North Industries 1 AS. In relation to the dissolution a total number of 50,832,449 shares in Reach Subsea ASA owned by the subsidiary has been transferred from the subsidiary to North Energy ASA at a price of NOK 6.66 per share, total NOK 338,544,110.

North Energy ASA and North Industries 1 AS are close associates of primary insider Rachid Bendriss (chairman of the Board in Reach Subsea ASA).

As a consequence of the restructuring and the transfer, North Energy ASA now holds 50,832,449 shares in Reach Subsea, representing 15.53% of the shares in the company.
However, at North Energy’s group level there is no change in the ownership of Reach Subsea ASA.
